svg.title: Wire-rope lifting sling — Vírlyftistroffa
svg.desc: A slender diagonal wire sling has a formed eye at each end and a few visible rope-lay marks.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-wire-rope-sling","label_en":"Wire-rope lifting sling","label_is":"Vírlyftistroffa","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["rigging","sling"],"description":"A slender diagonal wire sling has a formed eye at each end and a few visible rope-lay marks.","design_note":"Thin parallel cable contours and compact end eyes distinguish wire rope from broad flat webbing.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
